title: EquipmentShare Secures Seventh Consecutive AutoTech Breakthrough Award as "Overall Fleet Management Company of the Year"
summary: EquipmentShare announced it has been named "Overall Fleet Management Company of the Year" in the annual AutoTech Breakthrough Awards.
body_markdown:
**COLUMBIA, Mo. — October 19, 2026** — EquipmentShare.com Inc (Nasdaq: EQPT) (“EquipmentShare”), a leader in connected jobsite technology and one of the largest construction equipment rental providers in the United States, today announced it has been named "Overall Fleet Management Company of the Year" in the annual[AutoTech Breakthrough Awards](https://autotechbreakthrough.com/) . The prestigious honor marks EquipmentShare’s seventh consecutive annual award from AutoTech Breakthrough, reinforcing the company’s position as a leading innovator in connected jobsite and mixed-fleet management technologies.


"We built T3 because we live the exact same high-stakes challenges our customers face every single day," said Jabbok Schlacks, CEO and founder of EquipmentShare. "By running our own rental operations on T3 and powering what we believe is the best, most connected fleet on the planet with over 394,000 assets, we battle-test our technology at scale before it ever reaches a customer. Earning an AutoTech Breakthrough Award for the seventh consecutive year validates that approach. If T3 can bring greater control, safety and efficiency to a fleet of our size, it can connect even the most complicated jobsites out there."


EquipmentShare’s streak of AutoTech Breakthrough honors spans key categories driving connected fleets:


- **2026:** Overall Fleet Management Company of the Year
- **2025:** Fleet Management Technology Company of the Year
- **2024:** Vehicle Telematics Company of the Year
- **2023:** Vehicle Telematics Company of the Year
- **2022:** Driver Safety Solution of the Year
- **2021:** Fleet Management Innovation of the Year
- **2020:** Fleet Management Technology Company of the Year


At the core of EquipmentShare's technology ecosystem is[T3®](https://t3.tech/) — a vertically integrated, OEM-agnostic operating system designed to connect mixed fleets, tools and crews under one single pane of glass. T3 bridges hardware (trackers, dual-facing artificial intelligence cameras, near-field communication enabled keypads) with specialized software applications, turning raw telemetry data into actionable insights:


- The T3 Fleet app provides an interactive map showing precise asset locations, utilization, maintenance history and health metrics to make fast, data-backed fleet allocation, service and load balancing decisions.
- T3’s Driver Safety dashboard leverages intelligent-driven dual-facing dash cams to score driver behavior, spot emerging safety trends, assist in driver coaching and provide video evidence that can exonerate drivers when accidents occur.
- The T3 Work Orders app automates preventive maintenance tracking based on real-time engine hours and mileage, enabling inspection compliance and helping reduce jobsite downtime.
- T3 Keypads enforce user access permissions to help prevent unauthorized equipment operation and reduce jobsite theft, microtheft and operator injuries.


"T3 is a real-world solution for modern fleet managers. The lack of a unifying system creates a situation where massive amounts of data never translate into actionable insights," said Bryan Vaughn, managing director of AutoTech Breakthrough. "T3 replaces disjointed log-ins with a single, powerful platform where every machine, vehicle and tool is mirrored in real time — making it more efficient to manage operations from anywhere."


T3 is free for all EquipmentShare rentals and can be seamlessly installed across customer-owned fleets by EquipmentShare’s nationwide network of telematics experts. Experience the difference at[T3.tech.](https://t3.tech/)


**About EquipmentShare**
Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Columbia, Missouri, EquipmentShare (Nasdaq: EQPT) is a nationwide construction technology and equipment solutions provider dedicated to transforming the construction industry through innovative tools, platforms and data-driven insights. By empowering contractors, builders and equipment owners with its proprietary technology, *T3®* , EquipmentShare aims to drive productivity, efficiency, and collaboration across the construction sector. With a comprehensive suite of solutions that includes a fleet management platform, telematics devices and a best-in-class equipment rental marketplace, EquipmentShare continues to lead the industry in building the future of construction. For more information, visit[www.equipmentshare.com](http://www.equipmentshare.com/) .
